description: Establish a green baseline before making changes. Install dependencies and run the project's existing build, typecheck, and tests so we have a known-good reference to compare against after the AI Studio cleanup. This confirms the app is truly standalone (builds without any Google/Gemini/Firebase runtime).
steps: From the repo root /projects/sandbox/Built-Helion, run `npm install` to ensure dependencies are present (node_modules is already populated in the sandbox; this is a safety check).
Run `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and record whether it passes on the untouched tree.
Run `npm test` and record the result.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes, producing .vercel/output/ and dist/. Note that db:migrate should log that it is skipping because DATABASE_URL is unset.
Record the baseline results (pass/fail for each command) in this feature's findings field so FEAT-002 can confirm no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes successfully and creates dist/ and .vercel/output/.
Baseline results are written to the findings field of this feature file.

findings.npm_install: PASS. `npm install` exit 0: added 64, removed 16, changed 108, audited 606 packages; 0 vulnerabilities. (npm notice about npm 12 upgrade is informational only.)
findings.npm_run_typecheck: FAIL (tsc --noEmit exit 2) on the UNTOUCHED tree. Pre-existing errors, NOT caused by this task. Notable errors: src/engine.ts, src/physics.ts, src/webgpu-backend.ts reference modules (./audio, ./emitters, ./hash, ./soa, ./canvas-renderer, ./webgl-renderer, ./palettes) that resolve under src/engine/* but not from those root-level shim files (TS2307); src/engine/audio.ts(47,40) SharedArrayBuffer vs ArrayBuffer typing (TS2345); src/engine/emitters.test.ts uses stale ParticleSoA props 'pos'/'_count' (TS2561/TS2551); src/lib/firebase.ts(10,37) string|undefined not assignable to string (TS2345 — note this file is dead scaffolding slated for deletion in FEAT-002); src/physics.ts several implicit 'any' params (TS7006). Typecheck is NOT in the build pipeline, so the build still succeeds. Baseline: typecheck is RED before any changes.
findings.npm_test: FAIL (exit 1) on the UNTOUCHED tree. 195 tests: 179 pass, 16 fail. Failures are pre-existing and environmental — they depend on repo files not present in the sandbox (e.g. .grok/skills/og/references, SKILL.md/AGENTS.md marker paths, app-env template). Failing test names: #27 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md marker path, #28 brand-task prohibition, #29 SKILL.md self-check flag, #79 build side resolves template app-env, #89 platform chrome share-card metas, #101 grok.me slug title fallback, #105 og:image public host, #106 placeholder og:image hex color, #107 og:title entity escaping, #109 inject into no-head docs, #110 streaming injector </HEAD> case-insensitive, #113 app name in injected title, #178 template ships auth off, #180 wrapped command app env, #184 CLI via symlinked path, #194 og skill hand-over acceptance. Representative error: "ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '.grok/skills/og/references'". Baseline: test suite is RED before any changes.
findings.npm_run_build: PASS (exit 0). vite build completed, Nitro preset 'vercel' generated .vercel/output/{config.json,functions,nitro.json,static}; db:migrate logged '[migrate] DATABASE_URL not set — skipping (the PGLite fallback migrates itself).'; sync-dist.mjs copied artifacts to dist/. Confirmed on disk: dist/ EXISTS and .vercel/output/ EXISTS. All build acceptance criteria satisfied.
findings.summary: BASELINE (untouched tree): build=PASS (dist/ + .vercel/output/ produced), typecheck=FAIL (pre-existing tsc errors, not in build pipeline), test=179/195 pass with 16 pre-existing environmental failures. FEAT-002 should treat these typecheck/test failures as the pre-existing baseline and ensure it introduces NO NEW failures; the build must remain green.
